notes.title: Railroad to the Next Update
notes.content: [p]G’day! everyone[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Have you been enjoying the last update, “Night Market”? It was the one where a mysterious night vendor appeared at midnight and offered a variety of unique decorative items. Oh… have you already enjoyed it to the fullest and now feel like you need something new? Perfect timing then — today we’re here to share a little about the next update that will be coming soon.[/p][p align="start"]In particular, this update will introduce a new type of vehicle and also bring changes to the farm animal system. Since this isn’t just about decorative items, it may even change the way you play the game~! In addition, we’re working on improvements to multiplayer stability and various quality-of-life features based on the feedback you’ve been sending us.[/p][p align="start"]So, shall we take a look at some of the new content first?[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3][b]New Contents[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/c1a3ee785f2ffc7599bc0adfe40c0de9342c9f86.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]The first thing we’d like to show you is the new vehicle — the train. Dinkum already has many types of vehicles, but this train has a unique feature. To run, it needs proper tracks! (Just like in real life… haha.) Of course, you can place the train on areas without tracks, but it won’t be able to move![/p][p align="start"]Even with that limitation, the train is the fastest ground vehicle added so far. If the conditions allow, you’ll be able to run from one end of your island to the other without much trouble. We hope you’ll enjoy designing your island in even more creative ways with the train and tracks.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/5324f72c69769d3edbaaf9224977708fbead95e2.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]A new farm animal is also being added. Its cute appearance, resembling a bandicoot, is quite charming! In addition, there will be some new animals with a somewhat familiar appearance. Details on how to obtain and use these new animals will be shared later in the patch notes when the update goes live. Beyond that, a new system related to farm animals is also on the way, so we ask for your interest and excitement![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/23fe1f301f66a28de19884fc9e1c56207c6b7336.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3][b]Multiplayer and QoL Improvements[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Beyond new content, we are continuing to address long-standing issues that have persisted over time. Multiplayer inconveniences, in particular, have been among the most frequently reported and are a challenge we take very seriously. In this update, improvements to both performance and network quality will be made through a Unity engine update, and we’re looking forward to delivering a more stable and improved online play experience.[/p][p align="start"]Additionally, we’re incorporating other quality-of-life enhancements inspired by your feedback. These improvements are all about making gameplay smoother and ensuring you really notice the difference in your play environment.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3][b]Future Updates and Development Direction[/b][/h3][p align="start"]The update we’ve been talking about is targeted for release in October. Naturally, updates for Dinkum will continue beyond that. While nothing is finalized yet, discussions on new content and system improvements are ongoing. We’ve been exploring ideas like new terrain, maps, vehicles, tools, NPCs, and plenty of other fun things we believe you’ll enjoy.[/p][p align="start"]Rather than only showing finished results, we want to be more transparent by sharing the ideas and progress we’re working on. Moving forward, we aim to connect with you more often and more actively. For example, the character Mossy, who recently began streaming on Discord using screen sharing, is part of these efforts. Please see this as another way we’re making sure Dinkum continues to be something we build together with the community.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Since today’s post is just a small preview ahead of the official reveal of the next update, we weren’t able to share everything at once. We hope you’ll understand. Work on the update is moving forward each week, and once preparations are complete, we’ll share a more detailed preview in the form of patch notes.[/p][p align="start"]Your love and feedback are the driving force behind Dinkum’s growth. We’re always grateful for your support and will be back with you again soon. Until then, we hope you all enjoy your time![/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]See you in the game, Hooroo~![/b][/p]

notes.title: Dinkum Nintendo Switch Pre-Order Announcement
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/a243a0c63c6988e9587a02945cfeed9662da7be7.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]G’day everyone,[/p][p align="start"]We are truly delighted to finally share the news that many players have been waiting for. Yesterday, on September 12, during Nintendo’s online showcase event [i]“Nintendo Direct”[/i], it was officially announced that Dinkum will be released on Nintendo Switch. We are excited to bring this news once again to our community through this announcement.[/p][p align="start"]Dinkum, which has continued to receive steady love on Steam, is now stepping onto a new stage. With the Nintendo Switch platform, you will be able to enjoy Dinkum easily and conveniently, anytime and anywhere, right in the palm of your hands. This moment feels even more meaningful as it allows us to repay the support you have shown us for so long. Please see below for more details on the Nintendo Switch release.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3][b]Nintendo Switch Release Date and Pre-Order Information[/b][/h3][p align="start"]The official release date for Dinkum on Nintendo Switch is set for [b]November 6, 2025[/b]. Ahead of this, pre-orders began on the Nintendo eShop right after the Nintendo Direct event on [b]September 12[/b]. If you’re interested in the Nintendo Switch version, don’t forget to visit the Nintendo eShop and quietly add it to your wishlist~! A special bonus page has also been prepared for this occasion, so please check it out through the link below.[/p][p][url="https://dinkum.krafton.com/nintendo"]https://dinkum.krafton.com/nintendo[/url][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3][b]Pre-Order Discount Benefits[/b][/h3][p align="start"]To celebrate the announcement of the Nintendo Switch version, a pre-order discount benefit will be available.[/p][list][*][p]Pre-order period[/p][list][*][p]September 12, 2025, after the end of the Nintendo Direct event ~ November 6, 2025 00:00 (UTC)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Pre-order discount rate: 10%[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h3][b]Nintendo Switch Version Exclusive Items[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Players who purchase the Nintendo Switch version will receive an exclusive in-game Battlegrounds Costume Set as a special bonus. This item will be delivered via in-game mailbox after the official release and can only be accessed and worn on the Switch version. Even if you purchase the Nintendo Switch version after the pre-order period, you will still receive the bonus item.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/36245724147ac3fee0d3d0f39af4b4b7598233d7.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/ffst5ncgdyg"][/dynamiclink][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Since we anticipate various questions regarding the pre-sale, we have prepared a separate FAQ for the Nintendo Switch version to help you better understand. Please refer to the bottom of this announcement for details.[/p][p align="start"]We are deeply moved to finally be able to share the great news of the Nintendo Switch release. Meeting more players through this new platform carries great meaning for us. We will continue to provide a Dinkum service you can enjoy for a long time through various updates and steady improvements. We ask for your continued interest and support.[/p][p]
[/p][hr][/hr][p align="start"][/p][h1]Nintendo Switch version related FAQs[/h1][p][/p][h3][b]Q: Will cross-save and cross-play be supported between platforms (Steam/Switch)?[/b][/h3][p align="start"]A: Cross-save between platforms is planned to be supported in the future. Once we have more concrete details, we will share them through community announcements on Steam or Discord.
As for cross-play between platforms, there are no current plans, but we will continue to consider it positively while taking various conditions into account.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3][b]Q: Is multiplayer supported?[/b][/h3][p align="start"]A: The Nintendo Switch version supports multiplayer for up to 4 players. We encourage you to enjoy playing together with friends or acquaintances.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3][b]Q: Is there exclusive content for the Nintendo Switch version?[/b][/h3][p align="start"]A: The Nintendo Switch version will include a special Battlegrounds costume that can be worn in-game, exclusively available on this platform. You can receive this item through the in-game mailbox, and it will be available not only during the pre-order period but also at any time if you purchase the game afterwards.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3][b]Q: Are there differences in update timing between the Switch and Steam versions?[/b][/h3][p align="start"]A: The timing of updates may differ slightly between platforms.[/p][p align="start"]Ultimately, our goal is to ensure both platforms offer the same content experience, and we will gradually work to align update schedules.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3][b]Q: Are there plans to expand to Nintendo Switch 2 or other platforms?[/b][/h3][p align="start"]A: At this stage, we cannot confirm any releases or support for next-gen or other platforms, though various options are under review.[/p][p align="start"]If there is any new information, we will share it through official channels.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3][b]Q: Could the package price differ depending on country/region?[/b][/h3][p align="start"]A: In major regions such as the United States and Japan, the same pricing policy is applied.[/p][p align="start"]However, in some regions, differences may occur due to platform policies, exchange rates, or other external factors.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3][b]Q: Are there physical packages in addition to digital ones?[/b][/h3][p align="start"]A: We are reviewing the release of physical packages in several regions, and once confirmed, we will provide official announcements.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3][b]Q: Where can I find patch notes or major news for the Switch version?[/b][/h3][p align="start"]A: The official Dinkum Discord will cover both the Steam and Switch versions.[/p][p align="start"]By visiting the official Discord, you can check all major Dinkum updates, from announcements to event information.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Q: Will the game be playable on Switch 2?[/b][/h3][p][b]A:[/b] Yes, Switch 2 supports backward compatibility, so you will be able to play the game as a Switch 1 title.[/p][p]Please note, however, that it will run with the same graphics and performance as on Switch 1. We are also planning to prepare a dedicated Switch 2 version as soon as possible.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3][b]Q: Can the save file from the demo version be carried over to the full version?[/b][/h3][p][b]A:[/b] Yes, if you purchase the full version, you’ll be able to continue using your save file after the official release.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]See you in the game. HooRoo~![/b][/p]

notes.title: Collecting Play Environment Information for Multiplayer Improvement
notes.content: [p]G'day! everyone.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve been consistently identifying various inconveniences and issues reported through the Steam discussion board, Discord, and customer support regarding the multiplayer environment. Despite various efforts, including engine updates, to improve the multiplayer environment, we recognize that some players are still experiencing difficulties due to numerous variables such as region of residence, internet connection, and PC specifications.[/p][p]As mentioned, multiplayer-related issues are caused by a wide range of factors, and in order to address them, we need to collect information about your gameplay environment. If you have experienced any of the multiplayer issues listed below, we kindly ask that you submit your information via the prepared link. This will help us analyze the data more thoroughly and work toward providing a better multiplayer service.[/p][p][/p][h2]Gameplay Environment Information Collection[/h2][p]If you have experienced any of the following issues, please submit your information via the [url="https://forms.gle/EAhoycQBxjwGnndr7"]link[/url] below.[/p][p][url="https://forms.gle/EAhoycQBxjwGnndr7"]https://forms.gle/EAhoycQBxjwGnndr7[/url][/p][list][*][p]Disconnected during multiplayer and lost game progress[/p][/*][*][p]Unable to enter specific areas during multiplayer[/p][/*][*][p]Differences in progression time or acquired resources between host and guest players[/p][/*][*][p]Crash occurs when trying to sleep and save the game during multiplayer[/p][/*][*][p]Unable to exit NPC conversation or accept quests during multiplayer, making further gameplay impossible[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]msinfo File Collection[/h2][p]One of the data we collect includes uploading the msinfo file. This file contains comprehensive information such as your PC’s hardware, system components, software environment, and IP. If you prefer not to upload this file, that is completely fine. notes.title: Creative Mode & Steam Achievements – Things to Know
notes.content:
[b]G’day, everyone![/b]

The official launch update is just around the corner! Not long ago, we introduced a preview of some of the upcoming changes included in the launch update. Among all the update contents, the one that garnered the most attention and inquiries from players has undoubtedly been Creative Mode.

Creative Mode is a system designed to help you decorate your island in a more creative and free-spirited way, saving time and effort, and sometimes simply satisfying your curiosity. However, because enabling Creative Mode would make it too easy to complete standard Steam achievements, [b]we’ve implemented a system where any save file with Creative Mode enabled will not be eligible to earn Steam achievements.[/b]

To help prevent players from enabling Creative Mode without knowing about this limitation and then losing access to Steam achievements on their valuable save files, we’ve added a warning message that will pop up in-game when you select a mode (as shown in the screenshot below). Still, just in case someone misses the message, we’re also making this announcement to raise awareness—so please be extra cautious!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/3a146675b8ade2e0c4376b6217b92d7a0a753645.jpg[/img]


The Steam achievement system for Dinkum is currently in development. While we can’t give you an exact date yet, we’re working hard to make it available to everyone as soon as possible. For now, there are no achievements displayed, but once the system is implemented after the official launch update on the 23rd, any save file that has ever used Creative Mode will be excluded from achievement tracking—so please choose carefully.

To help prevent and resolve any potential issues, please refer to the following precautions and solutions:
[list]
[*] Play a different save file that does not have Creative Mode enabled to unlock achievements.
[*] Start a new game and play through it to unlock achievements.
[*] Back up your existing save files and replace them in case any issues occur.
[list][*]Default save file location - C:\Users\[User name]\AppData\LocalLow\James Bendon
[/list][/list]

Lastly, regarding the Steam Achievement system we mentioned is currently under development — we’ll share more details in a separate announcement as soon as they are finalized.
We’re also planning to host a Steam Achievement Contest soon on the official Discord, where you can submit your fun and creative ideas!
We can’t wait to shape the future of Dinkum together with you. Your interest and participation mean the world to us!

 
If you want to chat about the game, come hang out on our [url=https://discord.gg/dinkum]Discord[/url] full of Dinkum discussions~


See you in the game~ Hooroo~!

notes.title: Official Launch Update Patch Notes Preview
notes.content:
*2025.04.22 Update – Removed note stating pergolas can be placed overlapping


G'day, everyone!

Here are the patch notes for the long-awaited official launch update! Packed with new things to play with, this update makes the world of Dinkum more vibrant and enriching. It's the perfect time to invite your mates over to your island and enjoy all the new fun together! You can even take them on a scenic ride in your two-seater plane to show off your beautiful island from above.

Along with all this new content, the update brings tons of improvements for a smoother and more stable gameplay experience. Multiplayer permissions have been refined to easily manage what your visitors can and can't do. Several quality-of-life upgrades have also been added to make your time in Dinkum even more pleasant.

Oh! To celebrate the official launch, James, our dear creator of Dinkum, has sent us a special message. Let's all give him a warm round of applause and take a look!

[hr] [/hr]

[i]G’day everyone!

It’s been nearly 3 years since I released Dinkum into early access, and nearly 8 years since I started work on developing Dinkum.

In that time Dinkum has gone from a little project on my computer, to being played by thousands of people. Players who’ve truly made the game their own.

It’s been my finest pleasure to watch people play Dinkum, to see all the creations players have made on their island and to hear the stories and memories people have made inside that little game that used to live only on my computer.

So, for that I say thank you so much for playing Dinkum.

In the 3 years of early access I’ve been adding to Dinkum, offering updates with new items, features and adventures to experience. These updates have been shaped by the excitement and passion I have received from Dinkum players, as well as the hundreds of suggestions left by the Dinkum community.

So for that I wanted to say thank you to the community that helped Dinkum make it to 1.0.

After all the updates and new content added over the years, I believe Dinkum now feels complete. So that is why I’ve decided to leave early access and officially launch Dinkum. 

This doesn’t mean the end of Dinkum, and it certainly doesn’t mean the end of updates. All this means is: Dinkum is no longer in early access.

I hope you enjoy all the new features I’ve added in this update, a lot of these features are highly requested features. Some of them were hard to implement, but I believe they were worth the effort.

Thanks for taking your time to read this message. 

And as always, thanks for playing Dinkum.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/8e4b8b892bf1cf5af54ce25690a73871e3fc5dd4.jpg[/img]

[hr] [/hr]

As always, there's nothing better than jumping straight in and trying them out for yourself. But if you want to study the details, check out the full patch notes below.


[b][h2]Update Schedule:[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] April 23, 2025 at 02:00 (UTC)
[*] No downtime maintenance required.
[*] If you are already in the game, you can continue playing. However, to access the update content, please exit the game, install the update, and then restart the game.
[/list]


[b][h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]
[h3]New Features[/h3][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/74126e7a2587a777eb9adbf3c585ff728c2d0b4e.jpg[/img]
- Creative mode has been added.
[list][*] In Creative mode, players can open their inventory and access the creative toolbar.
[list][*] Players can search and add items to their inventory.
[*]Players can swap to the time / weather tab to adjust the in-game clock and weather.
[*]Players can spawn Animals into their world.[/list][*]Once switched to Creative Mode, Steam achievements will be permanently disabled for that save file, so please choose carefully. (The Steam achievement system is currently in preparation. Further details will be provided at a later date.)
[*]When selecting a save for single-player mode, players can press the cog icon to switch to default or Creative mode.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/22d097df540f41acbdfeaaf2d4d00b04b011abf3.jpg[/img]
- The Town Bell has been added.
[list][*]The Town Bell Deed is unlocked after completing the Town Hall.
[*]The Town Bell can be rung by interacting with it or hitting it with a weapon or tool
[*]Once the bell has been rung, all players currently on the island can see an icon for each villager on their map (these icons last for 30 seconds).
[*]Now, you don’t have to worry about Fletch getting lost and wandering off somewhere.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/2a3f8247327ac3f91dd94a503c84170549edf06d.jpg[/img]
- A Bug Terrarium has been added.
[list][*]Terrariums will create cocoons when butterflies, moths, and spiders are placed into them.
[*]Players can place the cocoons into a spinning wheel to produce silk.
[*]The Bug Terrarium Recipe is unlocked when players reach level 30 in Bug Catching.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/d4c8b048a613e567455533e1b52ec1c0c3aa99f5.jpg[/img]
- New guest houses have been added.
[list][*]The number of guest houses (extra homes) that can be built has increased from 3 to 4.[/list]
- Guest houses can now be rented out.
[list][*]Players can buy a Rental Sign from John’s Goods and place it at the door of a guest house to rent it out.
[*]Interacting with the sign once it’s placed will allow players to check the current rent, and the rent is automatically calculated by scoring the house’s interior decoration.
[*]If the sign is placed there, one of the four new villagers will move in the next day.
[*]The rent will be left on the small counter by the door of each guest house every Wednesday morning.
[*]Players can take Guest Houses on and off the market whenever they wish.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/46b627dbd1b9007d170850ecc4dd862619571974.jpg[/img]
- Four new villagers have been added.
[list][*]Players can meet new villagers after they move into a rented guest house.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/b5f2ff4e7a098fd4086b944e9a1f969099a5a5e7.jpg[/img]
- A new vehicle – Plane – has been added.
[list][*]The plane can carry up to two players (A Pilot License is required to pilot the plane, but passengers can ride in the co-pilot seat without a license).
[*]The plane flies faster than the helicopter but cannot hover in place.
[*]The plane can land and float on water.
[*]Franklyn can craft if he learns the recipe by giving him enough old discs and completing the berkonium mission (players who have met these requirements may need to offer Franklyn at least one shiny disc for him to discover the recipe).[/list]
- Gold Ore and Nuggets have been added.
[list][*]When the island is experiencing a heat wave, there is a chance to dig up this very valuable treasure.[/list]
- Villagers now have Inventories.
[list]
[*] Villagers have their own inventory that can be accessed through a dialogue option while hanging out with them.
[*] Players can give villagers helpful tools to use while hanging out.
[*] While hanging out, they will use items from their own inventory to assist the player depending on the situation.
[*] When hanging out with a villager, they will rush over and revive the player if they’re nearby when the player is passed out. How reliable!
[/list]
- Villagers can now wear clothing.
[list]
[*] Villagers may change into clothing in their inventory. So be sure to think about what they would like to wear the next time they ask for some new clothing.
[/list]
- Villagers now have a new type of request.
[list]
[*] New dialogues have been added to decrease repetition for most villager requests.
[*] They may ask players to collect specific items depending on the season.
[/list]
- Villagers now have random behaviors.
[list]
[*] Villagers now behave more naturally – eating random items from their inventory, fishing in the river, or catching bugs.
[*] When villagers have conversations with each other, they may occasionally show speech bubbles or emotes. If the player is nearby, they can read the dialogue.
[/list]
- 3 new outfits have been added.
- 19 new furniture and decoration items have been added.
- 2 new bridges have been added.
- 15 new cassettes have been added.


[b][h3]Changes[/h3][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/ca115b59047781c792a380d97d7feed78b617b3a.jpg[/img]
- Island permission settings have been changed in multiplayer mode.
[list][*]In multiplayer mode, the host of the game can access Island Permissions via the Settings tab.
[*]The host can set their default permissions if it’s a visitor’s first time on the island.
[list][*]If they have already visited the island, their permissions will be set to their last saved value.[/list][*]The host can change a current visitor’s permissions by clicking the cog icon in the visitor list.
[list][*]Creative: Players have access to the creative toolbar. (Host must also be in creative to see this, otherwise all players will not have access)
[*]Open containers: Players can open chests and interact with their content.
[*]Item pick up/drop: Players can pick up or drop inventory items
[*]Edit house: Players can decorate the interiors of both the host’s house and guest houses, and they can pick up tile objects. House customization kits can be used to customize the houses.
[*]Terraform / pathing: Players can dig, plant grass seeds, and place and pick up pathing.
[*]Edit island: Players can place down and pick up tile objects outside of houses.
[*]Interactions with vehicles: Players can use vehicles.
[*]Interactions with farm animals: Players can milk, shear, and sell animals.[/list][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/b16956ffad5af86490e42e3f122810dd2380d0f4.jpg[/img]
- Farm animals can now get dirty or sick.
[list][*]Farm animals will be set to clean, dirty, or sick depending on their cleanliness.
[*]Dirty animals will have brown dust clouds around them while sick animals will have green sickness particles.
[list][*]Sick animals do not produce drops.[/list]
[*]Use the Animal Brush sold at Irwin’s Barn or craft an Animal Shower at the workbench to manage your farm animals’ cleanliness.
[*]Take good care of your adorable and precious farm animals![/list]
- Boomboxes can play new tracks by placing Cassette tapes in them.
[list][*]When players are close to the boombox, the existing music in the world will fade away.
[*]Cassette tapes can be found in various ways, including from NPC shops, mine chests, and the visiting trader Jimmy. 
[*]Its volume can be adjusted through the Music Volume setting.[/list]
- Recycling Bin changes
[list][*]Instead of gifting the player a recycling bin, John now teaches the recipe for the recycling bin.
[*]More than one Recycling Bin can be placed on the island, but only one has a chance of having something in it on a new day.
[*]Items are cleared from ALL the Recycling Bins every Thursday.[/list]
- Host action changes
[list][*]Visitors can now see farm animals in the book.
[*]Any quests that give the players a recipe (nail and crate recipes) can now be completed by visiting players.
[*]Villagers relationship quests (such as John’s Recycling Bin or Rayne’s Plant Book) can also be completed by visiting players.
[*]However, quests that are town/building specific can still only be undertaken by the host player (Get John to move in, Unlock the Town Hall, etc.).[/list]
- Pergola and Festoon changes
[list][*]Other items / decorations can be placed under pergolas and festoons.
[*]The obstacle detection area for pergolas and festoons has been changed to the four corner tiles.
[*]Any tile under it (excluding the corners) can be decorated.[/list]
- Food can now be eaten while inside any building.


[b][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][/b]

- Fixed an issue where some content appeared awkwardly or incorrectly in certain language environments.
- Fixed an issue where item names and tooltips would appear outside the UI or overlap in certain language environments.
- Fixed an issue where the language settings window would automatically appear in certain situations, preventing other game settings from being changed.
- Fixed an issue where the icon color of some outfits did not match the item color when worn.
- Fixed an issue where chat input would not appear when using certain languages.
- Fixed an issue where riding the Mu mount did not increase progress for the 'Giddy-Up' achievement.
- Fixed an issue where standing on the wooden double bed made the character appear to be floating.
- Fixed an issue where the recipe box was misaligned in the to-do list after using the 'Check Ingredients Continuously' feature.
- Fixed an issue where some dragonfly models protruded outside the insect box when placed inside.

If you want to join our amazing Dinkum Discord community, click right [url=https://discord.gg/dinkum]HERE[/url].


[b][h3]Enjoy your Dinkum life! Hooroo![/h3][/b]

notes.title: Two Years of Early Access, and the Journey to Official Launch
notes.content:
G'day, everyone!


It’s hard to believe, it's already been 2 years and 8 months since Dinkum first launched in Early Access back in 2022. Just like when you received your first tent from Fletch, Dinkum began its adventure in a humble and simple way. And just like when you welcome new villagers to the island, Dinkum was able to meet more and more players over time. By listening to the invaluable feedback from the players, Dinkum has continued to grow through a series of updates both big and small. Much like building John’s shop or Theodore's museum, the world of Dinkum has been expanding, one step at a time.

Once your town expands, everyone on the island throws a celebration, after spending a year at their new home. Now, we feel it's time for Dinkum to celebrate its own milestone as well. After collaborating with our players for 2 years in Early Access, we're thrilled to reveal that the time has come for Dinkum's official launch!

[b]We're incredibly excited to announce that Dinkum will be finishing Early Access and officially launching on April 23, 2025, at 02:00 UTC![/b] We truly believe we wouldn't have made it to this point without your constant support, feedback, and love for the game. So first and foremost, thank you to each and every one of you who has been part of the journey so far. As a part of this monumental announcement, we'd like to share some of the key content and a few changes related to game services that will be applied for the full and official release.



We understand that many of you have been yearning for the multiplayer environment to be improved. We're delighted to inform you that the hosts will have more control of what their guests can do on their island, and guest players have access to features that were once available to the host only.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/788251f86b3aa2e52602918d6bcaf0c55fbfb02a.jpg[/img]

We're also introducing Creative Mode, allowing you to build and shape your own Dinkum world with more freedom and imagination than ever before. We can't wait to see what you'll create!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/baf20191628353682ac5b7f1dc28b8d0b30ea674.jpg[/img]

Another exciting addition is the rental system for guest houses. Alongside it, 4 new villagers will be joining Dinkum! You'll be able to meet them by renting out the guest houses, and each one comes with their own unique charm and personality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/78c89e50a8e867963662f5a4e296045f0eb5199d.jpg[/img]

In the field of crafting, new recipes can be bought and discovered. Thought you'd done it all after crafting the helicopter? Try out the new two-seater airplane, perfect for exploring the skies with a friend. We're only getting started, as the 1.0 Update will also include new activities to be discovered, as well as improvements to convenience functions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/646cc99bfab112b646f0b0009ef109c559ecc8a4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/34ae43ad724c27ffbdab032828efe0bcc4942f40.png[/img]

More details will be revealed in the patch notes as we draw closer to the official launch date, so please stay tuned!



In addition to the new content mentioned above, we'd like to share a few updates related to the game services for the official release. Throughout the 2 years of Early Access, Dinkum has followed Steam's recommended regional pricing guidelines. Although the pricing standards changed several times, we kept the game's price unchanged during the entire Early Access period.

The main reason behind maintaining the original pricing was to ensure that as many aspiring adventurers as possible could explore Dinkum and try out the game without too much pressure. Since launch, Dinkum has released 5 major content updates—including House Warming and Bloomin' Spring—all completely free and with no paid DLC. We intend to continue this approach moving forward as much as we can.

However, as Dinkum is now enjoyed by players in over 170 countries, we've noticed some inconsistencies in regional pricing. With the official launch, we'll be making slight adjustments to align prices more closely with current exchange rates and global economic conditions. We understand that due to these adjustments, some regions may see more noticeable price changes than others. We kindly ask for your understanding as we apply these necessary updates to prevent inconsistencies in regional pricing. Please note once again that this adjustment only concerns the price difference, and the base price in USD remains unchanged.

These pricing changes will go into effect with the official launch on April 23, 2025. Until then, players will still be able to purchase the game at its current price. For those who already own Dinkum, these changes will not affect your access to or experience with the game at all.

Also, Dinkum will be featured in an upcoming Steam Free Weekend. During this time, all players will be able to try the game for free and purchase the game at 20% off under the Weekend Deal. We sincerely hope you'll take advantage of this opportunity to join the adventure if Dinkum has caught your interest. (The discount offer ends on April 10.)

Thanks to the growing number of players enjoying Dinkum, we've received many requests to bring the game to more platforms beyond PC. To live up to such expectations, we're thrilled to reveal that we've been working toward that goal. We hope to deliver some exciting news about releasing Dinkum for one of the popular gaming consoles later this year. We'll be sure to share more information as soon as everything is ready. We truly appreciate your interest, we are also looking forward to the console version as much as you do!



That brings us to the end of today's announcement where we have briefly talked about the game's official release and other accompanying changes. The official launch is now just around the corner and we are striving to make sure it's something special for everyone. We can't wait to reveal more information, so please stay tuned. We'll be posting detailed patch notes and update schedules in the near future.

The end of Early Access marks not just a conclusion, but the beginning of a brand new journey. We're incredibly excited for the future of Dinkum—a future we'll continue to build together with all of you! With a heartfelt promise to keep striving to bring you the best experience possible, we'd like to once again thank every one of you who has supported and enjoyed Dinkum.

See you at the official launch!

notes.title: KRAFTON Q&A
notes.content:
To the dearest fans of Dinkum,

Since KRAFTON joined Dinkum's passionate journey, many of you have shared various thoughts and questions.
We truly appreciate your engagement, and we will try our utmost to listen to the voices of our community.

To help clarify some of the most frequently asked questions following the publisher change, we have compiled a list of explanations below.
We will continue to openly communicate with you and share updates whenever there is new information.

[h3]1. Is KRAFTON now developing Dinkum?[/h3]
[list]
[*] No, Dinkum is still solely developed by James Bendon, while KRAFTON handles publishing activities.
[*] KRAFTON has partnered with James through a publishing agreement to introduce Dinkum to more players worldwide and make it available on multiple platforms so that new players can discover and enjoy the game.
[*] As part of this collaboration, KRAFTON now handles global operations, including marketing, promotional campaigns, localization, community management, and customer support. We will actively engage with players, gather feedback, and discuss potential improvements with James to enhance the game experience.
[*] Furthermore, KRAFTON provides legal support to protect the Dinkum IP and administers service and business operations, ensuring that James can focus entirely on development.
[/list]

[h3]2. Will Dinkum's direction change due to this collaboration?[/h3]           
[list]
[*] No, KRAFTON will not unilaterally change the direction of the game.
[*] We will listen to community feedback and work closely with James to support the development of even more attractive content.
[/list]

[h3]3. There was an announcement regarding data administration. Does this mean my personal data is being accessed or used by KRAFTON?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Since KRAFTON has assumed the publishing role for Dinkum, we have published a notification to make sure that players recognize this change.
[*] However, The way personal data is handled remains unchanged, and access to such data is strictly limited.
[*] Furthermore, All data is securely managed with encryption and other protective measures to ensure user safety.
[*] You can find more details [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1062520/view/500565141418410026]in the official announcement[/url].
[/list]

[h3]4. Why do I need to agree to the EULA again to play Dinkum?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Since KRAFTON has assumed the publishing role from James, the End User License Agreement (EULA) has to be reaccepted by players, following the publisher change on the Steam platform.
[*] This is a standard procedure that all game publishers must adhere to and an essential requirement that the platform provider must follow to administer the game service.
[*] The EULA update is an essential step to ensure stable service and protect player rights without impacting the ownership of the game or the individual's way of playing the game. Through these protection measures, players can safely enjoy Dinkum in the same environment as before without any disadvantages or restrictions.
[/list]

[h3]5. Is Dinkum Together a completely separate game from the original Dinkum?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dinkum Together is a new title inspired by the original Dinkum, designed to offer a fresh and delightful experience on various platforms.                  
[*] Since the game is still in its early stages of development, there isn't much detailed information to be shared yet. However, we will make sure to post regular updates through [url=https://discord.com/channels/892654052989628436/1297866927770697759]the Dinkum Together Discord channel[/url], so please stay tuned for more news.
[/list]

We sincerely apologize for the insufficient communication provided regarding the publisher change, as our focus was directed toward the language support update. Moving forward, we will strive to improve our way of interacting with the dearest fans of Dinkum by delivering more precise information. Thank you to everyone who shared their valuable feedback.

Once again, thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Flaming Winter Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Dinkum's latest update “Flaming Winter” is live and ready to play!

If you want to go in totally blind, you can stop reading here and start playing. But for those who want a bit more detail, please keep reading.

[previewyoutube=8U9BEHPx27E;full][/previewyoutube]

When you start playing, you might notice that winter in Dinkum feels a lot cooler.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/ed1989efd99bfff82bbe06ddc4f4ae2f9e88ea54.png[/img]

Snowfall can now occur in winter! Sometimes during winter, it will snow on your island instead of rain. If you get super lucky and it snows in the morning, your island will experience a snow day. On these days, snow will cover the landscape of your island, you’ll hear the snow crunching under your feet and you might even find some other unique occurrences around your island. So be sure to go exploring on a snow day. 

Snow days will be somewhat rare, but they will occur more often if you have a way to to control the rain on your island…

Now, there’s a sneak peek at the “winter” part of the update. What about the “flaming” part I hear you ask?

Well, I’d like to introduce a new level of the mines, a level even deeper than the Undergrove…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/622a846667c9c5acda2d341cd856556c047ac255.png[/img]

Welcome to the Hot Hot Hot.

This 3rd level of the mines is the most dangerous level yet. So dangerous in fact, that the peaceful wish doesn’t seem to affect its denizens.

This mine level is intended to be visited by late game players. You’ll want good gear, good food and maybe some good friends to help you explore the lava filled depths. There are large dungeon-like structures to loot for new treasure, and rare Berkonium nodes to find and return to the new Gem Crusher near the mine's entrance.

Well, I think that covers both the Flaming and the Winter parts of this update. I'll leave it up to you to discover all the other new things you can find in this update. But, if you're the type of person who needs an even more detailed breakdown, the patch notes are down below.

James

notes.title: Celebrating two years of Dinkum

Did you know that Dinkum was released on July 14th two years ago? Back then, I wasn’t sure if anyone would play my little game. So I wanted to say a big thank you to everyone who has played!

To celebrate the second Dinki-versary, John once again has his anniversary event running full-time. He’ll give you a ticket for every fish sold to him. Once the anniversary event has ended, John will return to running this event only during the first week of every summer, starting in year 2. So get out there and do some fishing!

Finally, Milburn is selling something in the bank. I’ve heard that it makes banking more convenient on the weekend? That might be something you want to look into as well.

I hope you enjoy hunting down and collecting the new items included in this mini update.

I will be back soon with an updated roadmap, and I’m excited for what's coming next for Dinkum.

Thanks,

James

notes.title: The Breezy Autumn Update is Here!
notes.content:
G’day!

Can you sense the cooler breeze on your face and notice the trees changing colours? Do you find yourself reaching for a blanket at night or an extra jumper in the early morning? Are the temperatures outside rather comfy, with the sun no longer scorching you in seconds? If you’re feeling that cooler change, it can only mean one thing: Autumn has arrived in Dinkum. And this season’s Autumn has brought along the [b]Breezy Autumn Update![/b]

[previewyoutube=ZD0ggC_mr7Y;full][/previewyoutube]
When you stroll around your island, take a look around and see how more colourful this Autumn is. The trees have changed to shades of gold and orange, and if you’re paying attention during the night, you might see [b]a new weather event[/b]. This rare event will happen more often during the Autumn and Winter seasons.

But don't just look up at the sky; take a moment to notice the [b]Mushrooms[/b] sprouting from the ground. Different varieties of mushrooms will appear across the island during autumn mornings, but they will wilt at noon. You’ll want to gather these mushrooms nice and early, so you use them to cook up [b]new food recipes[/b] or utilise them in crafting [b]new items[/b]. Who knew these tiny fungi could be so versatile?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/88b2384f3281a8a9ddc6212a8b7c6ec5158d1789.png[/img]
[i]As the nights grow chilly, there are always some ways to stay warm.[/i]

But it’s not just the weather! With this update, I’ve added some new items and quality-of-life changes that will make gameplay a lot more breezy! 

John now sells the handy [b]Hand Trolley[/b], capable of moving full containers! No need to empty containers before relocating them - convenience at its finest. In addition, building licence level 3 now gives access to the crafting recipe for the [b]Advanced Crafting Tables[/b]. These fancy new tables can pull crafting resources from nearby chests, allowing players to craft up a storm. 

Oh, and Franklyn now offers a new contraption that will make sorting items from your inventory and into containers much easier. You might need to give him a shiny disc to make him learn it, but I’ll leave that as a surprise for you to discover!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/7066f997c2d03d51ff250e3ed9484ba9ef71c8ee.png[/img]
[i]If you're looking to lighten your workload, consider investing in a Hand Trolley.[/i]

Another big change I’m excited about is the [b]Wish Fountain[/b]. This new deed is available from the beginning of the game, so you can speak to Fletch if you want to build one on your island.

The Wish Fountain can be used to make “wishes” that change how your Dinkum island behaves. These wishes last forever, but you can only have one wish in effect at a time.

For example, you can wish for your island to be peaceful, which makes animals only attack you if you attack them. You could also wish to make your island more dangerous, but this will make animals drop twice as much loot. There are a few more wishes, but I’ll let you discover them for yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/1a9efc155254f8074895e38b64162dae2d9bfe6b.png[/img]
[i]What will you wish for?[/i]

This is just a taste of some of the new content that’s available to you with the new update. There is a new seasonal event that appears in Autumn if you have a Band Stand on your island. There is also a new stamina system, new fish, bugs, crops, clothing, and crafting recipes to discover.  

Download the Breezy Autumn Update now and see what changes and additions you can find! And if you want to know the full list of them, check the changelog below. And as always, let me know your thoughts and comments below!

Have fun playing and speak to you soon!

James

notes.title: Hotfix 0.8.1 - A message about save files
notes.content:
Hi there. I just wanted to let you know that I am aware that some players have been having issues with saving and loading their games.

Since releasing Dinkum I have paid as much care as possible to keeping player’s saves throughout the entire Early Access period. This always has been and continues to be very important to me.

For the Summer Sun Update we made a lot of changes to the internal of Dinkum, including writing a new save system. The old system was very bloated - it had far too many separate files and often caused problems with Steam Cloud syncs. The new system is much smaller, taking the file amount down from around 60 files to just 3.

The Summer Sun update was tested publicly for over three weeks, this was in part due to my concerns with the new save system. Over those 3 weeks, a lot of bugs were reported, but no issues were found relating to players using the new save system.

However, since the public release, some rare cases of save file corruption have been reported. For anyone that has experienced this I would like to sincerely apologize. I know how much some player’s islands mean to them and I can not express my regret enough.

I have been working tirelessly on improving the new save system and I’ve included these changes in this hotfix. I am hopeful that these changes will mitigate any further problems.

Once again, I apologize if your save was affected by these changes.

I hope this hotfix prevents these kinds of problems in future.

Thank you everyone for your understanding and patience,

James

And if you're craving more details, check the changelog below.

And finally, now that the Summer Sun update is out, I’ll be slowly getting ready for the final 1.0 Dinkum release. Don’t worry though, as I have a lot more ideas for new content for you before the big final release. I’ll tell you all about it soon, but in the meantime, enjoy the new update. notes.title: A tease of what's coming to Dinkum Island
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

I know you’ve all been waiting patiently for the Summer Sun update. I want to make sure this update is the best it can be. So once again, I’m going to regretfully ask you to wait just a little bit longer.

There have been some exciting things happening behind the scenes that I can’t share just yet. Things that I know will make a big difference in Dinkum’s future, and some other things that need to be done if Dinkum is ever going to leave early access.

So yeah, there has been a lot of work being done to Dinkum’s core. This work makes it much easier to change or add things to Dinkum, but in the end, a lot of these changes won’t be visible to players.

That being said, I want the Summer Sun Update to have a bunch of new things that really extend Dinkum’s endgame experience.

So why don’t I give you a little sneak peek of two features I think are really cool?

The first thing I want to show: Dinkum now has dynamic weather patterns that can change throughout the day. This means the sky might be clear during the day, but it might rain at night time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/e8b5c94d1825b116319b72bc46b1565490ee12e3.png[/img]
You’d be surprised how much this adds to Dinkum, not only does it make the world feel more alive, it also adds some interesting choices for players to consider. For example, a player might want to check if it’s going to rain later in the day before they water their crops.

This new weather system is much more powerful than the old version. So it will be easy to expand on and add new weather events in the future.

Now this is something I’m really excited to show off. There is a new building to construct on your island.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/b7d48e1491faf9fab7b2ae916db14318cbe294b1.png[/img]
For now, I’m just calling it the “Airport”. This is an endgame building, so you’re going to have to meet certain conditions to build one on your island.

Once your Airport is built, every now and again you’ll be able to catch an Airship off your island for the day. These little excursions will be similar to a mine trip, but a lot more breezy. You might find some new treasures and new materials to craft with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/6d15ed37654ccd68339f4605bb55fc3988f87427.png[/img]
Hmmm… looks like there is a lot of water though? I wonder what other kinds of things you’ll be doing on your trip off the island? I hope you can wait just a little bit longer to find out for yourself.

Speak to you soon,

James

notes.title: The Bloomin’ Spring Major Update is Here!
notes.content:
G’day everyone,
 
I hope you are all doing well this morning, afternoon, or evening, wherever you may be. I’ve been working on new Dinkum content for quite some time, and I am now happy to announce that the second major Dinkum update is ready for you to play! With the [b]Bloomin’ Spring update[/b] a new resident is joining our community, some new wildflowers will spring up on the Island, you can build a new building in your town, dive deeper into the deep min, and many more surprises that I left here and there for you to find. If you want to know more details about what’s coming to Dinkum, keep on reading. But if you don’t want to spoil the fun of discovery, you can jump into your Dinkum island and find the surprises yourself. Whatever option you choose, I hope you enjoy all the new content. Ok, I’m just about to get into more details, so if you don’t want spoilers, now is the time to go!! But before you do, thank you for your support!

[previewyoutube=YwlNtbXORTQ;full][/previewyoutube]
You’re still here? In that case, let me tell you more about the Bloomin’ Spring update. From today you can say hello and become friends with [b]Sheila[/b], our new villager on Dinkum Island. You can find her at your local Visitor Site. Sheila loves food and her hobby is cooking. She is known to make some tasty tucker. If you want her to move permanently to your town, you’re going to have to cook up some treats for her. Sheila is the owner of [b]Tuckerbox[/b], a local tuckshop. And if you collect all the necessary materials to build it, she will happily run it for you and all the other residents so that everyone on the island can enjoy her treats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/91cd7b2bb5b39e92f74cf21a651958717875d4ea.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/75c0d686c72f1263719bc20cc20eb80418f0d7fb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/f4d5c57eb89a29e28bbb6c782e88430c530b7741.png[/img]
[i]Sheila and her Tuckerbox have a lot of comfort to offer.[/i]

When spring starts, some new [b]wildflowers[/b] will start appearing all over the island. Keep your eyes open for Jackaroo Paw, the Flannel Flower, River Daisies and a bunch of Paper Daisies Rayne has started selling Jacaranda saplings in her greenhouse. These are available all year, but blossom into a bright purple colour in spring. What can be better than the back garden full of flowering plants. And that smell!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/07560132a5eaddd70ac1fe212c16cf821ff52c70.png[/img]
[i]Is there a better way to relax than taking a nap in your garden?[/i]

From now on you can also add a [b]Band Stand[/b] to your town! This is a place to host events, parties, gatherings, and celebrations. If you want to build one, just talk to Fletch and you will build it in no time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/196f42347ae2a1630e966e6dbe158aa473d8f019.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/122c21d73bfdb976b6c65234a2deb356b24acdaa.png[/img]
[i]Can’t wait to see what events we can have here![/i]

Are you looking for a way to organize your town a little bit better? Perhaps making it easier to navigate? Or perhaps you would like to commemorate some special places? Well from now on you can place [b]signs[/b] which you can use to mark directions, highlight spots, or just to upgrade the look of the town’s street. Before you can place them, speak to Fletch first and get a Sign Writing Licence – thanks to that licence you will get The Sign Writing Table, a pen, and a few sign recipes. With these, you can start putting signs anywhere you like!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/eed969c012f40341551d658b9db8d97db6b12a1e.png[/img]
[i]Is it possible to have too many signs?[/i]

Well, there's a sneak peek, but I’ll leave you with the fun of discovering all the other new additions. There’s plenty of new stuff that isn’t mentioned here, but if you really, really, really want to know more, check out the changelog below. And before I go, I just want to thank you all for all your help, your comments, feedback, and support. You have no idea how much it means to me to get such positivity from all of you. So once again, thank you and I really hope you like the new update! 

Speak to you all soon,
James

[b]New[/b]

Hey there,

I've had my head down working hard on Dinkum's next update. I really wanted to have it ready for everyone to play in early February, but things are taking a little bit longer than expected, so I will need a bit more time.

The Bloomin’ Spring update is the first of many updates where I will be focusing on a specific season. My goal for this update is to make the in-game Spring feel different to the other seasons by offering different events and new things to discover around the island.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/7f14432c69fdfc3a137caa9dbd525178fe16c106.png[/img]

I would like to keep some of these things a surprise, but being Spring, you can imagine there will be a lot of wildflowers spawning around your island. Another change I’m happy to share is the sun now sets at different times in each season. Winter being the shortest day with the sun setting around 6pm like usual. Summer and Spring have longer days, with the sun setting around 8pm-9pm.

I have been teasing some of the upcoming items and features through screenshots on Dinkum's [url=https://discord.com/invite/dinkum]Discord[/url]. But I have some new pics to show off here as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/775d43c7e514c5af84d7694d48fe3146f22dac5d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/52dc942673db8732051fb18a152f0c6729cd7119.png[/img]

Things like crates and chests now have an auto stack button, for stacking all the items from your inventory straight into the chest’s stack. There is now a "collect and delete all" button for collecting all your mail at once. This will hopefully make trapping rewards a bit less tedious. Oh and Theodore will now accept more than one donation at a time at the museum, so you can get back out there and catch even more fish and bugs for him.

There is a bit more that’s coming in the next update, but I will tell you all about it next time - unless Fletch beats me to it! And I hope you all understand that I want this update to be as good as it can be. I do appreciate your patience and I hope you don't mind waiting just a little bit longer for it. That’s all for this post, so I’m going to get back to working on the update.

Thanks,

James

notes.title: Dinkum Community Census Results
notes.content:
G’day everyone,

Over here in Australia, it’s starting to get warm and we’re slowly getting ready for summer. Hope you’re feeling warm and cozy too, wherever you are. I want to thank all of you who took the time and participated in the last Dinkum Community Census. I have to admit that I didn’t expect so many of you to take part in it - there were nearly 10 thousand people who filled out the survey! And a big thank you to those of you who left some words of support and love in the Census. Reading them filled my creative juices to the max! 

So let’s quickly summarise the results of Dinkum’s Community Census.

First up, I’ve asked you [b]how you like Dinkum in its current stage on a scale of 1 - 10[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/c04bd540fe2bb9174b224c56181df2c7bfee184f.png[/img]

Most of you rated Dinkum in the 7 to 10 range, with 8 being the most frequently chosen value. That means you are quite happy with the game’s current stage, which makes me really happy to see! Of course, this doesn’t mean that the development ends here - oh no! This is just the beginning. 

Next question - [b]which mode you play the most[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/9f39098c87a3b2f88c96e4d96f625b0f26421d1f.png[/img]

It looks like more than half of you play Dinkum in a single-player mode, and a quarter of you play a bit of both. That really took me by surprise. This doesn't mean anything will change going forward with multiplayer support. After all, more than 45% of you are playing Dinkum with friends at some point. Your thoughts and suggestions are being listened to. 

Now let’s see [b]what you like the most about Dinkum[/b].

From all your answers I could pick a few of the most common responses, which were:

- The Australiana theme.
- Building the town, ability to decorate, and being able to express yourself through designing and building.
- Farm Animals and wildlife.
- That the game is relaxing (chill and cozy).
- That you can play with family/friends.
- Exploration - finding little interesting things, stories, items, and how they work with each other.
- Ability to customise the character.

- Mines need more variety / are too scary and too difficult / pass is too expensive.
- Tools durability / breaking too fast.
- Terraforming is a bit fiddly. 
- Cooking - too few recipes and not balanced.

The good thing is that a lot of the ideas that you had and the things that annoyed you the most are the things that I wanted to focus and work on too. It was good to know that we all feel a little bit similar in which direction Dinkum should head. All of your info was super valuable and if I make any major changes to the roadmap, I will let you know! 

Thank you once again for filling out the Census and thanks for playing Dinkum. I’ll see you all on the island!

James

notes.title: House Warming update is here!

G’day everyone,

Today is the day that you can enjoy brand-new Dinkum content as the [b]House Warming update is here![/b] While the update is downloading, let me tell you a little bit more about it.

One of the first updates you will come across is a [b]new wild animal - The Frilly[/b]. They are inspired by one of my favourite native Australian creatures. You will find Frillies roaming around in the desert biome. But be careful around them! These fellas are fast and if provoked, they will fight back! They have a very quick bite and another surprise if you make them angry enough. If you do manage to kill one you may receive a thunder sack with which you can use to craft a new item - which might be quite useful while exploring the underground.

[i]Looks like this Frill really wants to catch us![/i]

Next up on the new content list are the new [b]Guest Houses[/b]. From now on you will be able to add up to three of them on your island. You can use them as a place to store all your crops and farming materials in one place, or maybe you need a house for all your hats? Better yet, they can be a place for your friends to stay when they come and visit your island. So build a few and make your friends feel at home. The deeds for these will be offered by Fletch once you’ve upgraded your tent into a house. I am sure you will find a great use for them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/a93dc7ec25a39ec4d10ee90707fc8d5266f17686.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/43665f1c429b8b310db7cd67240908cbb8a4430b.png[/img]

[i]Sally can now move to the Island! Looks like the town is about to get more stylish.[/i]

But, another common suggestion was to allow you to customise your crates and chests. So now you can colour crates and chests using paint to help you keep track of what crate has what.

Thanks to your comments and suggestions, I’ve also added the ability to key-bind up to two different keys per action. However, rebinding for gamepads is something that needs a bit more time, sorry! I want to make Dinkum as accessible as it can be for all players, so I will continue to make these kinds of changes.

There are a bunch of other new items, recipes and secrets to track down in this update as well. I wanted the first update to be a bit bigger than what was on the road map, so I hope you all enjoy it. Also, a big thank you to everyone in the Dinkum community and Discord for all your help and support so far. I’m so grateful to have a bunch of creative, funny and kind people playing my little game. notes.title: Steam Cloud Saves are now available for Dinkum!
notes.content:
G’day all,

I can now officially say that Steam Cloud Saves are now available for Dinkum! From now on you can enjoy Dinkum on more than one device without manually moving your save.

Cloud saves will sync for the first time after you close Dinkum. For most people, you wont need to do anything else. 

However, if you have been moving your saves between devices, please give these points below a read.

[olist]
[*] If you are playing on more than one device and have been moving a save from one to another, copy your latest save to both devices to ensure it syncs with your latest save.
[*] If you have been playing on more than one device and have different saves on them both, move both saves to both devices. The save slots can have their numbers changed so they don't conflict.
[*] If for any reason you need to copy and paste saves into your save folder after a sync has happened, you should do it while the game is open and on the menu. Once the game is closed, it should sync all the files you have copied in.
[*] If you don’t want to use Cloud saves, you can opt out by right clicking on Dinkum in your library and looking at cloud settings.
[/olist]

If you have any more questions regarding Cloud Saves, feel free to write them down below. We also have a great and helpful community on [url=https://discord.gg/BPT2DnjNpm]Discord[/url]! So if you are looking for help, or just want to meet some nice people, join us there. And as always, thank you so much for your support and feedback. I am so grateful that Dinkum has such a great community and it means a lot to have you all around :) 


Have a great day, and speak to you soon,

James

Oh, and if you would like to join the Dinkum Discord, you can do so right [url=https://discord.com/invite/NgB9FzERPU]here[/url]. 

Oh, and I want to give a big thank you to everyone who has Wishlisted Dinkum over the years. Wishlists help a lot when you're launching a game on Steam, so it means a lot to me that so many of you have given Dinkum a Wishlist.

As some of you noticed, I’ll be launching Dinkum in Early Access. The main reason I’m launching into Early Access is to help build the game with the community in mind. I can’t wait to see how you build your town, what you do on your island, and hear all the suggestions and feedback. I feel good about the content that Dinkum has now, but I want to hear what you think the game needs going forward. There might be things you would like in Dinkum that I hadn’t even considered. And seeing your feedback is always really exciting to me. 

I know I haven’t been the best at keeping everyone updated with development, but I want you all to know that I will be active and transparent about Dinkum’s development throughout Early Access. 

I’ve been putting together a Roadmap for development. This will definitely be ready before launch, but I need a bit more time. There are certain features on there that I think will make Dinkum better. But, I want to allow the Roadmap to shift around a bit, depending on how the community is playing and what kind of feedback people are giving me.

Dinkum has been developed by one person and this one person is very thankful for everyone that has waited patiently for Dinkum.

Only two weeks to go now! I can’t wait for all of you to play Dinkum!

James Bendon

notes.title: Character Customisation: How to express yourself on the Island
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/784c0c76b991cdac13086f66bf51acdf863dd63d.png[/img]

G’day mate!

In less than 3 weeks you will arrive on Dinkum Island. Isn’t that exciting!?! The 14th of July is just around the corner! I, Fletch, the Head of Island Exploration (*proud face*) will make sure that everything is ready for your arrival. After all, such an honourable resident like yourself doesn't move in here every day, ha ha ha. In the meantime, let me tell you more about character customization. Every one of us is a one-of-a-kind individual and we want you to be able to show off your uniqueness. 

Before you put your first steps on the Island’s soil, you have to create your character. In Dinkum, you can customise your character in five different categories: skin tone, hair, and eyes, the shape of your nose and lips, and last but not least, the colour of your shirt (the last one is really important ha ha ha). You will get a few options to choose from in each category. Or if you want to go nuts, click the Randomise button and find out what result you will get!

[i]This is where you become… you![/i]

Once you are happy with your look, you can move to the next screen. Now will be the time to have a good think about your name. This is what you will be known as in Dinkum! Take your time, pick your name, and get ready to start your adventure.

You are probably thinking, is that it? Is there something more I can do to express myself? Of course there is! This is just the beginning.


[b]New Clothes[/b]

If you are looking for some new clothes, make sure to visit the talented Clover and her shop, Threadspace. You can buy beautiful dresses, all kinds of shirts, hats, boots, glasses, pretty much everything that every fashionista could dream of. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/92b82c44b64883a191b42ec4113244899cb218d4.png[/img]
[i]Clover will help you find all kinds of clothes you might need.[/i]

[i]There's no one better in Dinkum than Sally when it comes to hair.[/i]

notes.title: Meet your friendly barn friends! The farm animals of Dinkum.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/784c0c76b991cdac13086f66bf51acdf863dd63d.png[/img]

G’day mate!

Howzit goin!? It’s been a very busy week for Dinkum. Two great game shows, a looot of new friends on our Dinkum Discord, and heaps of work behind the scenes on the game. While the works on the game are still progressing (the Release Date is soo close!!! *panicking*) how about I make the wait a bit more bearable. Let's take a closer look at all the furry and not that furry friends that we’ll meet on Dinkum Island. So let me introduce this multicultural flock to you now.


Let me start this update by saying what place you have to visit first to buy and adopt all your animals. Of course I’m talking about [b]Irwin’s Barn[/b] that you might’ve read about some time ago. And if you, by any chance, haven’t heard about this nice gentleman, you can read all about him right [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1062520/view/3347876586285111439]here[/url]. So, Irwin is the man you have to ask if you want to buy some animals for your farm. And while you are already there, have a look at what else he has to offer. Animal food, animal feeders, shears, animal whistles, and milking buckets can be very useful if you want to take good care of your farm friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/f00ca5615818c06faad2c2f2f903c6a26328a149.png[/img]
[i]Irwin will help you find your new furry or feathery best friends.[/i]

Oh, and I almost forgot, when you finally buy your new companion, you can name it as you like. As long as you think it suits them! ha ha!

Since you already know where you can find everything you need, let me introduce to you all the animals you can adopt.


[b]Chickens[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/3d776f5f85de3a5a9b521c63854db31243b35e41.png[/img]

When you find the perfect place for a home for your chickens, the first thing you should do is fence the area! You don’t want your cute chicks to be eaten by some wild animals simply because they were let loose - they need to live to the fullest and longest they can! When the fence is done, you can put a few Bird Coops in there - I’m sure they will love their new little homes. Put some Animals Feeders too and you are ready to invite your new friends. Feed them, pet them, visit them, show them some love and they will love you back in no time! Not only will you make great friends, but you can also enjoy fresh eggs. Pick them up, and cook meals with them, or just sell them and make some extra Dinks.


[b]Vombats[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/d68b5d67b4fda37cc8acecb3f989202152d497fd.png[/img]

Get an Animal Stall if you want to add large animals to your farm. And by large (not fat) I mean Vombats! Those nice big fellas love cuddles. Give them a pat once in a while, and they will love you for it. Keep their home nice and tidy, feed them regularly, and they will live happy long lives. Oh and you can milk them too!


[b]Pleeps[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/2d464e1743886b763cdaaae6bd648e6afa5f2e81.png[/img]

Would a farm be a farm without Pleeps? It would, but it would be a very sad one. If you want to have these sweet animals, you have to get an Animal Den first. Place their cozy home wherever you like and you are ready for adoption. Pleeps love water so consider building a small pond for them. I wish I could swim as well as them! And if you want, you can shear them too. Aren't these animals amazing? It’s like multiple animals in one!!!


To be able to have all those animals on your farm you have to get a proper license first. Don’t be sad though, just come to me (Fletch) and I will tell you all about how to get it.

That’s it for today. I hope you enjoyed this little update. Next time I will tell you more stories about Dinkum. There are still a few things worth showing before we arrive on July 14th. 


Hooroo!

Fletch - Head of Island Exploration

notes.title: Living the Farming Life
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/784c0c76b991cdac13086f66bf51acdf863dd63d.png[/img]

G’day mate!

It’s me, Fletch. Sorry to bother you again but we don’t have the time to waste. There’s a lot to do on Dinkum’s Island, and the more you know, the more you will be able to do. Ha ha! I want to tell you more about farming itself. Soon you will be able to grow your own veggies, isn’t that exciting?! There are heaps of them too! Ok, let me get back to the point, I know that sometimes I talk too much…


[b]Farming[/b]

There’s nothing better than watching your plants grow all nice and strong. And if that’s still not enough of a reward, you can eat delicious crops afterwards! In order to enjoy the fruits of your labor (no pun intended!), you must first choose a place for your vegetable beds. Clean the wildland from all the grass, rocks, and trees. Tools such as a scythe, pickaxe, axe, and shovel will help you with this task. Once the land is cleared you can build a fence around it. After all, those tasty goodies are for you to eat, not for the wild animals!

Now it’s time for some sowing. A Hoe will help you prepare the soil. In Dinkum you can grow sugar cane, cabbage, carrot, corn, kale, potato, wheat, watermelon, pumpkin, onion, tomato, and green bean. Make sure you visit Rayne’s Greenhouse (once it’s built of course) to buy those seeds. She can sell you some gardening tools too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/5141c0294ae9a1e9fbe63c158795ff8550cb531f.png[/img]
[i]Rayne has everything every gardening enthusiast needs.[/i]

Once your seeds are planted, all that remains is waiting for the harvest. Please, don't forget to water your plants! Without water, nothing will grow. You can water in the traditional way using a watering can, or if your farm has grown to a really large size, you can use an automatic watering system - sprinklers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/42e7d5479be2b3a56cfe64d6fc2f318ffdebe0bb.png[/img]
[i]You can also add an extra boost to your plants - a fertilizer. With it, your veggies will grow faster.[/i]

Build your farm, take good care of your plants, and soon you will be able to enjoy these tasty, fresh, colorful veggies. I'm getting really hungry just thinking about them… *stomach growling* 

You can eat your veggies raw, use them as ingredients in your dishes, or simply sell them and earn some Dinks. Whatever you do, you’re already a winner! And there’s nothing better than growing your veggies with a friend. Maybe a family member or a friend would like to help out as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/48afcddff7d2f1bf7bc99c72e509db989f17a115.png[/img]
[i]Working with friends is always more fun.[/i]

Ok, that’s enough from me. The rest you will have to figure it out yourself, mate! I will speak with you soon and I’ll have some more new info to share with you as well.


Have a good one!

Fletch - Head of Island Exploration

Once the formalities are behind us, you can choose where you want the building to be placed. For the construction work to start you still need to deliver some materials to the site. If you are a real green thumb, you love gardening, and plants, you should definitely consider building a Greenhouse. Go and visit Rayne if you want to buy some tools to help you grow your own veggie garden. She has plenty of seeds too!


I hope that you enjoyed this little guide. Can’t wait to finally take you to the island. Our trip will begin very soon as Dinkum is coming this year. I’ll tell you more about the date in the not-so-distant future. And stay tuned for part 2. I will show you even more buildings and people that you will meet.

notes.title: Dinkum is an Aussie farm life sim with wombats as big as an ox
notes.content:
While my knowledge of Australian fauna is limited, I’m quite sure that wombats are not close to six feet tall. This makes upcoming outback life sim Dinkum and its giant fuzzy pals objectively better than reality. Due in the first half of 2020, it looks like a hybrid of Animal Crossing and Stardew Valley (or Harvest Moon, for that matter) with a bit of kangaroo hunting and barbecuing. It’s the work of solo dev James Bendon, native to a quiet little corner of Australia and inspired by his travels around the vast deserts and bushlands of the country. There’s a debut trailer down under.

(more…)
